summary: CORS whitelist hardening verified. Backend now restricts allow-origins to the 4 whitelisted hosts (hrdigitalservices.in, www.hrdigitalservices.in, haryana-solar-app.emergent.host, rooftop-solar-jobs.preview.emergentagent.com). Ran 15 pytest cases covering OPTIONS preflight + actual GET/POST for both allowed and disallowed origins on /api/vacancies, /api/vacancies/stats, /api/enquiry. All 15 passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 1078 uses os.environ.get('CORS_ORIGINS', '*').split(','). Default fallback of '*' combined with allow_credentials=True is a foot-gun: if CORS_ORIGINS ever gets unset, Starlette/FastAPI will refuse credentialed requests. Consider defaulting to an empty list [] or raising on missing config so misconfiguration fails loudly.
allow_methods=['*'] and allow_headers=['*'] combined with allow_credentials=True is permissive; consider tightening to explicit method/header lists if not required.
seed_data_creation: One enquiry row created via /api/enquiry with prefix TEST_CORS (Pydantic model uses full_name/mobile/service fields). Safe to leave; can be filtered by email test_cors@example.com.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CORS is locked down to 4 origins in /app/backend/.env. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_cors.py parametrizes allowed vs disallowed origins for preflight + real requests. If the whitelist changes, update the ALLOWED list in the test file. Enquiry endpoint expects fields: full_name, email, mobile, service, message.

verification_details.allowed_origins_preflight: OPTIONS /api/vacancies returned 200 with access-control-allow-origin echoing the request Origin for all 4 whitelisted hosts.
verification_details.disallowed_origins_preflight: OPTIONS /api/vacancies with evil.example.com / localhost:9999 / malicious.attacker.io — no matching ACAO header, no wildcard leaked. Browser would block.
verification_details.no_origin_regression: GET /api/vacancies without Origin header returns 200 with vacancy list (server-to-server unaffected).
verification_details.stats_and_enquiry: /api/vacancies/stats GET and /api/enquiry POST both succeed from an allowed origin and echo the correct ACAO.
